jigglypuff-wish.name: Wish
jigglypuff-wish.description: Bond skill: a heartfelt wish heals itself or an ally up to 3 hexes away for 35 HP.

jigglypuff-play-rough.name: Play Rough
jigglypuff-play-rough.description: Bond skill: a rough-and-tumble scuffle with a foe (Power 90, Attack).

jigglypuff-hyper-voice.name: Hyper Voice
jigglypuff-hyper-voice.description: Bond skill: a booming song hits all foes within 2 hexes (Power 80, Sp. Atk).

jigglypuff-cute-charm.name: Cute Charm
jigglypuff-cute-charm.description: Its damaging hits on adjacent foes leave them Slowed (smitten) for 1 turn.

jigglypuff-competitive.name: Competitive
jigglypuff-competitive.description: Deals 20% more damage while it carries any status.

jigglypuff-disarming-voice.name: Disarming Voice
jigglypuff-disarming-voice.description: New skill: a charming cry at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 40).

jigglypuff-headbutt.name: Headbutt
jigglypuff-headbutt.description: New skill: butts the foe with its round head (Power 50), pushing it 1 hex.

jigglypuff-soft-body.name: Soft Body
jigglypuff-soft-body.description: Its bouncy body cushions blows: takes 10% less damage.

jigglypuff-long-lullaby.name: Long Lullaby
jigglypuff-long-lullaby.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

jigglypuff-disable.name: Disable
jigglypuff-disable.description: New skill: seals a foe up to 2 hexes away; Disabled (basic attack only) for 2 turns.

jigglypuff-mega-punch.name: Mega Punch
jigglypuff-mega-punch.description: New skill: a surprisingly hard punch (Power 70).

jigglypuff-gentle-heart.name: Gentle Heart
jigglypuff-gentle-heart.description: Heals 5% of its max HP at the start of each turn.

jigglypuff-puffed-up-rage.name: Puffed-Up Rage
jigglypuff-puffed-up-rage.description: Puffs up in anger: deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

jigglypuff-dazzling-gleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
jigglypuff-dazzling-gleam.description: New skill: a dazzling flash hits a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 80).

jigglypuff-slam.name: Slam
jigglypuff-slam.description: New skill: slams its round body into a foe (Power 80).

jigglypuff-fluffy-fur.name: Fluffy Fur
jigglypuff-fluffy-fur.description: Takes 25% less damage while at full HP.

jigglypuff-bouncy.name: Bouncy
jigglypuff-bouncy.description: Bounces away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

jigglypuff-moonblast.name: Moonblast
jigglypuff-moonblast.description: New skill: draws on the moon's power to blast a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).

jigglypuff-giga-impact.name: Giga Impact
jigglypuff-giga-impact.description: New skill: charges a foe with everything it has (Power 100).

jigglypuff-rude-awakening.name: Rude Awakening
jigglypuff-rude-awakening.description: Deals 25% more damage to Sleeping foes.

jigglypuff-last-encore.name: Last Encore
jigglypuff-last-encore.description: When it faints, the team gains 2 Bond.

jigglypuff-balloon-body.name: Balloon Body
jigglypuff-balloon-body.description: Capstone. Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP; adjacent attackers take 8 damage.

jigglypuff-superstar.name: Superstar
jigglypuff-superstar.description: Capstone. Status skills recharge 1 turn faster; Bond skills cost 1 less; +20% vs statused foes.
